jamie (Sales): heads up — AcmeHealth POC: traces not showing in their Splunk export, log-forwarder returning 429s. customer says no trace ids in console. Can ops help? :eyes:

devon (Eng): can you paste the raw request + any trace header? also which exporter config are they using (splunk_http/hec or datadog)?

jamie (Sales): sample request:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "x-rd-traceid: 0xabc123" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","prompt":"hi"}'
```
They said header gets stripped and console shows no trace.

maria (Support): looks like their nginx reverse proxy was dropping `x-rd-traceid`. I suggested `proxy_set_header x-rd-traceid $http_x_rd_traceid;` on their side. Also enable `preserve_trace_headers: true` in our console route.

devon (Eng): on the Redwood side you can flip it in the project settings — Telemetry -> Trace propagation -> Preserve headers. Config snippet:
```yaml
telemetry:
  preserve_trace_headers: true
  telemetry.debug: true
```
Then tail the forwarder logs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app=log-forwarder -c agent --follow
```

alex (SRE): 429s indicate their Splunk HEC index hit UF limit. Short-term workaround: increase forwarder backoff and reduce batch size. Set env vars on their log-forwarder deployment:
```
LOG_FORWARDER_MAX_BATCH=50
LOG_FORWARDER_RETRY_WINDOW=120s
```
I'll also enable exponential backoff in the next deploy.

jamie (Sales): is this going to block the POC sign-off? customer asked about pricing for Dedicated if this is resolved.

devon (Eng): not necessarily blocking. If you enable console streaming fallback to our hosted telemetry for the first 10m we can show traces immediately while they sort their Splunk quota. Console path: Console > Projects > acme-health > Telemetry > Exporter > toggle 'Fallback to hosted'.

maria (Support): I updated their nginx rule and pushed `preserve_trace_headers`. Can you re-run the curl above? @jamie

jamie (Sales): re-run now — I see trace 0xabc123 in Console, can drill into span tree. :tada:

ops-bot: log-forwarder v1.4.2 deployed to staging (rollout id: r-5632)

alex (SRE): creating follow-up Jira: RD-POC-4321 to track permanent fixes (increase HEC quota / add queueing). I'll loop in platform to add telemetry docs. @jamie can you confirm customer is unblocked?

jamie (Sales): confirmed unblocked. I'll include a note in the handoff doc and ask about Dedicated pricing next week. Thanks everyone :heart:
